_comment: Curriculum roadmap for the daily 'new unit' scheduled task. Every run, the task builds ONE new unit for EACH of the 6 CEFR levels (not a rotation anymore). Each level's 'queue' is an ordered list of not-yet-built units — the task pops the first item off each level's queue, builds it, removes it from that queue, and bumps that level's nextUnitNumber. If a level's queue is empty on a given day, that level is skipped for the day (noted in the run summary) while the other levels still get built. If ALL 6 queues are empty, set _needsMoreRoadmap to true and stop. From 2026-07-11 onward, this roadmap is grounded in the site owner's own teaching decks (uploaded: Adv/Disadv, Cause & Solution, Direct Question, and Opinion essay guides for Task 2; Bar Chart, Line Graph, Pie Chart, Table, Process/Diagram, and Map decks for Task 1). It systematically walks students through her real essay taxonomy (Opinion/Agree-Disagree; Advantages & Disadvantages in its two forms — no-opinion vs 'do advantages outweigh disadvantages'; Cause-Solution in its three often-confused forms — Solution Essay, Cause-Solution Essay, Problem-Solution Essay; and Direct Question in its four forms by number of questions asked) and her real Task 1 chart taxonomy (bar, line, pie, table, process/diagram cycle vs man-made process, and map with its tense rules), each introduced at the CEFR level where its complexity fits, using her actual structural rules (intro-overview-body paragraphing, word count targets, grouping/selectivity rules for tables, tense rules for maps, pie-chart phrase bank, etc.). As of 2026-07-20, all six level queues built from this taxonomy are complete — every level's queue is now empty and the site owner should add the next batch of planned units before the next run.
